name: Fiona Campbell
bio: Fiona's journey into the world of motorsport IT began unexpectedly. After earning a degree in Computer Science from the University of Edinburgh, she initially worked in the finance sector. However, a chance encounter with a rally team during a local event ignited a passion for the fast-paced environment of racing. She transitioned into motorsport, starting with data analysis roles before moving into infrastructure management. At Peugeot TotalEnergies, Fiona ensures the smooth operation of all IT systems, from race simulations to data acquisition. She's known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to quickly diagnose and resolve critical IT issues. Her focus is on reliability and efficiency, ensuring the team has the information they need, when they need it.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Fiona is of average height with a practical, no-nonsense appearance.

quirks: Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, despite the noise.
Always has a spare USB drive attached to her keychain.
Prefers to communicate technical solutions with hand-drawn diagrams.
